@needs_git
    def test_acceptance_pass_with_missing_diff_evidence_becomes_fix_required(self):
        root, workspace, state, logger, sources = self.make_runtime()
        state.task = "Erzeuge answer.py mit answer() == 43."
        (workspace / "answer.py").write_text("def answer():\n    return 42\n", encoding="utf-8")
        state.files_changed.add("answer.py")

        reviewer = ScriptedClient([
            json.dumps({
                "verdict": "PASS",
                "summary": "Die Anforderung sei erfüllt.",
                "checks": [{
                    "requirement": "answer() muss 43 zurückgeben.",
                    "path": "answer.py",
                    "evidence": "return 43",
                    "reason": "Der geforderte Rückgabewert sei sichtbar.",
                }],
                "issues": [],
            }),
        ])
        controller = AgentController(
            ScriptedClient([]),
            state,
            logger,
            sources,
            reviewer_client=reviewer,
        )

        result = controller._run_acceptance_review(
            "Coder behauptet vollständige Umsetzung.",
            {"summary": "Erster Review meldet PASS."},
        )

        self.assertEqual(result["verdict"], "FIX_REQUIRED")
        self.assertTrue(any("Acceptance-Nachweis ungültig" in issue for issue in result["issues"]))
        events = (root / "events.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        self.assertIn("ACCEPTANCE_EVIDENCE_INVALID", events)
        self.assertIn("return 43", events)

    @needs_git
    def test_acceptance_pass_with_exact_diff_evidence_is_accepted(self):
        root, workspace, state, logger, sources = self.make_runtime()
        state.task = "Erzeuge answer.py mit answer() == 43."
        (workspace / "answer.py").write_text("def answer():\n    return 43\n", encoding="utf-8")
        state.files_changed.add("answer.py")

        reviewer = ScriptedClient([
            json.dumps({
                "verdict": "PASS",
                "summary": "Die Anforderung ist belegt.",
                "checks": [{
                    "requirement": "answer() muss 43 zurückgeben.",
                    "path": "answer.py",
                    "evidence": "return 43",
                    "reason": "Der geforderte Rückgabewert ist im finalen Diff direkt sichtbar.",
                }],
                "issues": [],
            }),
        ])
        controller = AgentController(
            ScriptedClient([]),
            state,
            logger,
            sources,
            reviewer_client=reviewer,
        )

        result = controller._run_acceptance_review(
            "Coder-Selbstreview.",
            {"summary": "Erster Review meldet PASS."},
        )

        self.assertEqual(result["verdict"], "PASS")
        self.assertEqual(result["checks"][0]["evidence"], "return 43")
